skills.description: Self-honesty guardrails for long-running agent work. Provides the kappa (κ) presence model, a three-tier S/K/X constraint system, and a tri-state verdict discipline that prevents an agent from silently swallowing failures, reporting unverified success, or looping on environment walls. This skill should be used when an agent maintains a long-lived service, runs periodic health checks, debugs flaky or partially-broken pipelines, or whenever a task risks producing optimistic-but-unverified status reports.
